name: herma
summary: Herma: programmable AI request middleware for configurable coding harnesses — intercepts outbound LLM calls via keyword, semantic, and micromodel triggers to inject versioned rules, provisions, and URIs before model execution. Provisions load from SQLite, Tessera (herma.provisions CAS records and tessera://blobs/<sha256> excerpts), or remote handshake servers; generic consumer chat assistants and contributor-tier models are deterministically refused.

status.notes: Schemas, configurable-harness gate, 3-tier trigger engine (keyword, semantic, micromodel), SQLite/Tessera/remote-handshake provision store, multi-protocol injector (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages, /v1/dry-run), FastAPI service with edge lockdown, CLI, and Cloudflare Worker edge built and verified.

components.title: RFC 9457 error hierarchy
components.role: Maps typed middleware, scope, harness, and contributor-tier refusals to deterministic HTTP statuses

components.title: Provision, trigger, key, and receipt schemas
components.role: Strict Pydantic models for provisions, URIs, 3-tier triggers, harness keys, and SHA-256 injection receipts

components.title: Configurable-harness access gate
components.role: Verifies constant-time hmk_ secrets, enforces route/configure scopes, refuses generic consumer chat surfaces, and blocks -contributor models

components.title: Three-tier trigger engine
components.role: Evaluates Tier-1 keyword/regex/path/tool, Tier-2 semantic cosine, and Tier-3 micromodel classifier triggers with short-circuiting

components.title: Provision store and backing-store sync adapters
components.role: SQLite WAL store with compare-and-set updates, SHA-256 hashed harness keys, receipts, Tessera CAS/blob sync, and remote handshake sync

components.title: Multi-protocol context assembler and receipt builder
components.role: Extracts prompt/path/tool signals across chat_completions, responses, and messages, injects provisions + URIs within budget, deduplicates prior turns, and mints SHA-256 receipts

components.title: Interception and upstream forwarding engine
components.role: Evaluates active provisions and forwards augmented payloads (JSON or SSE stream) to allowlisted upstream LLM endpoints

components.title: FastAPI HTTP service and read-only console
components.role: Serves proxy and provision-sync endpoints behind HERMA_EDGE_SECRET lockdown plus read-only HTML overview/connect pages

components.title: Command-line interface and end-to-end demo
components.role: Provides seed, keys, dry-run, 3-tier Tessera-synced demo, and serve commands

components.title: Cloud Worker & Edge
components.role: 24/7 native Cloudflare Worker + D1 (ta-amps-herma) + Tessera Cloud Service Binding running 3-tier trigger evaluation, multi-protocol injection, and receipt persistence, with optional STORAGE_MODE=origin fallback

invariants.statement: Generic consumer chat assistants, browser navigation requests, and cookie-authenticated calls are deterministically refused
Provision management and remote sync require both configure scope and explicit matching X-Herma-Harness attestation
Contributor-tier models (-contributor) are refused across outbound LLM payloads and micromodel trigger classifiers
Tier-1 keyword, bounded regex, path-glob, and tool-name triggers match deterministically without network calls
Tier-2 semantic triggers match paraphrased intent without literal keyword overlap
Tier-1 or Tier-2 hits short-circuit Tier-3 micromodel calls when trigger mode is any
Compare-and-set versions prevent silent provision overwrites, Tessera blob URIs resolve deterministically, and remote handshakes clamp max_chars
Multi-turn conversations deduplicate once_per_conversation provisions and HERMA_EDGE_SECRET blocks direct origin traffic lacking x-edge-auth

import_rules.why: Ring 0 holds pure schemas, error contracts, and stateless harness access gates with zero I/O
Core trigger, store, and injection engines never depend on FastAPI or CLI entry points
Runtime package code never imports test, build, or deployment folders

claims.claim: Herma evaluates keyword, semantic, and micromodel triggers to inject versioned provisions and URIs across chat_completions, responses, and messages while refusing generic consumer assistants
Herma loads and syncs versioned provisions from both Tessera CAS/blob stores and remote handshake provision servers
